title: Send a macOS notification from the Terminal
summary: Use terminal-notifier to display a standard macOS notification banner with a custom title and message. This is useful for scripts that need to alert you when a task finishes.

steps.explain: Run terminal-notifier with a title and message to display a notification banner.

placeholders.name: GROUP_ID
placeholders.description: A unique identifier to group notifications together

placeholders.name: TITLE
placeholders.description: The bold title of the notification

placeholders.name: MESSAGE
placeholders.description: The body text of the notification

steps.expect: A macOS notification banner appears in the top right corner.

alternatives.explain: Display piped data with a sound.

placeholders.name: MESSAGE
placeholders.description: The text to display in the notification

placeholders.name: SOUND_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the system sound to play

alternatives.expect: The notification appears and plays the specified sound.
